page_title: VAL 1-2 OSA | Valencia v Osasuna 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 1 - 2 GOAL! And what a stunner! Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) finds space in the box to somehow acrobatically connect with the ball and send it past the keeper. 1:2.
90+5' The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is awarded a yellow card.
90+1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Javi Guerra (Valencia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a brilliant save.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
87' So close! Sergi Canos (Valencia) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.

86' Valencia slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
86' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
84' 61:39 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
80' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header inside the right post.
79' Pepelu (Valencia) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
77' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
75' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) is substituted due to injury. Ruben Baraja gives a chance to Cristhian Mosquera.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Ante Budimir (Osasuna) coming on for Raul.
73' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
70' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) replaces Aimar Oroz.
67' Here comes a substitution. Arnaiz Jose Manuel is given a rest as he is replaced by Johan Mojica (Osasuna).
64' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Hugo Duro (Valencia) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
62' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) picked up a yellow card from referee.
61' The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
59' Hugo Duro (Valencia) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
58' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francisco Perez.
58' Pepelu (Valencia) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
57' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
55' 7:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
51' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
50' Thierry Correia (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Juan Pulido interrupts the game.
49' Thierry Correia (Valencia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
48' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Jagoba Arrasate makes a switch. Nacho Vidal is coming on in place of Kike Barja (Osasuna) at the start of the second period.
46' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mouctar Diakhaby walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Juan Pulido has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
45+4' Francisco Perez (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+2' Francisco Perez (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
44' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just over the bar.
43' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Juan Pulido stops the game and makes a call.
42' Valencia take a short corner kick.

41' Arnaiz Jose Manuel (Osasuna) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
40' Pepelu (Valencia) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
38' Hugo Duro (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
36' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) is caught offside!
35' Kike Barja (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
34' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
32' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
29' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
27' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) calmly steps up and places the ball inside the right post.
23' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
23' Thierry Correia (Valencia) gets booked for the first time in this match.
23' Referee Juan Pulido is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna!
21' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
21' Thierry Correia (Valencia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna are about to take a penalty!
19' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Juan Pulido signals a foul.
16' Wonderful movement by Osasuna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
13' A wild effort from Jose Gaya (Valencia) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
12' Valencia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
10' Diego Lopez (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
9' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' Arnaiz Jose Manuel (Osasuna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals.
6' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
4' Osasuna are ruled offside.
3' Juan Pulido has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jose Gaya (Valencia).
1' The match has just started.
Valencia will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Pulido.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
